hyperedges.label: BlocX Core 1.1.0 Release & CI Verification Suite

nodes.label: BlocX Core v1.0.1 Release Notes
nodes.rationale: Fixes stale-response race conditions via loadGeneration and bloc_concurrency transformers, decouples pagination offset from local list length, and isolates EventHub broadcast errors.

nodes.label: In-Place Collection Search Model
nodes.rationale: BlocxCollectionSearchableMixin filters and displays results directly in the single active collection list with isSearching: true, reloading the normal initial list on clearSearch().

nodes.label: BlocxBaseEntity Identity vs Equality Principle
nodes.rationale: BlocxBaseEntity uses the contractual identifier getter for collection matching, deduplication, and stream sync while leaving operator == and hashCode untouched so subclasses can freely adopt equatable or freezed.

nodes.label: BlocX Core v1.1.0 Release Notes
nodes.rationale: Introduces cursor-based pagination, sortComparator for ordered insertion, clearError() on ScreenManagerCubit, per-bloc errorTranslator/localizations, and testing.dart utilities.

nodes.label: BlocX Core 1.1.0 Release Report & Quality Gates
nodes.norm_label: blocx core 1.1.0 release report & quality gates
nodes.rationale: Documents SDK floor alignment to >=3.8.0 (required by lints ^6.1.0 and bloc ^9.0.0), cursor pagination end-of-list and refresh fixes, and 103 passing unit tests.

nodes.label: flutter_blocx Companion UI Package
nodes.rationale: Official Flutter UI companion package that connects to blocx_core BLoCs without manual BlocConsumer, ScrollController, or TextEditingController glue code.

nodes.label: package:blocx_core/testing.dart Utilities
nodes.rationale: Provides deterministic in-memory test doubles (BlocxTestEventHub, FakePaginatedSource, FakeCursorPaginatedSource, FakeSearchUseCase) for unit testing BLoCs and UseCases.

nodes.label: BlocxCollectionBloc & 10 Collection Mixins
nodes.rationale: Composable collection state management supporting Infinite, Refreshable, Searchable, Selectable, Deletable, Highlightable, Expandable, Scrollable, Filter, and SyncStream mixins with loadGeneration concurrency protection.

nodes.label: BlocxBaseBloc, ScreenManagerCubit, ErrorTranslator & Localizations
nodes.rationale: Decouples UI side effects (snackbars, error pages, route pop) and error translation/localization from Flutter BuildContext using pure-Dart ScreenManagerCubit states.

nodes.label: BlocxFormBloc, BlocxBaseFormEntity, Validators & 5 Form Mixins
nodes.rationale: Manages strongly-typed enum-keyed immutable form entities with 4 validation modes, 35+ field validators, async uniqueness checks, reference data prefetching, multi-step wizards, and live EventHub entity synchronization.

nodes.label: BlocxBaseUseCase, UseCase Tasks & BlocxEventHub
nodes.rationale: Standardizes domain use case execution (perform vs execute), lazy task builders (BlocxUseCaseTask, BlocxPaginatedUseCaseTask), and automatic post-execution CRUD entity broadcasting via BlocxEventHub.

nodes.label: Dart Lints Recommended Configuration
nodes.rationale: Enforces package:lints/recommended.yaml for idiomatic Dart static analysis and pub.dev package scoring.

nodes.label: BlocX Core v1.0.0 Release Notes
nodes.rationale: Introduces Command-Driven EventHub, automatic UseCase entity broadcasting, BlocxCollectionSyncStreamMixin, BlocxFormSyncStreamMixin, and full Web/WASM compatibility.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions CI & Publish Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs formatting, fatal-info static analysis, and unit tests with coverage across Dart SDK 3.8.0 and stable, and publishes to pub.dev on push to main.

nodes.label: blocx_core Pubspec Manifest (v1.1.0)
nodes.rationale: Declares pure-Dart dependencies (bloc ^9.0.0, bloc_concurrency ^0.3.0, stream_transform ^2.1.1, collection ^1.19.1, uuid ^4.5.1, meta ^1.16.0) with Dart SDK >=3.8.0 <4.0.0.

nodes.label: blocx_core Package Overview
nodes.rationale: Pure-Dart BLoC architecture eliminating repetitive pagination, search, selection, validation, and cross-screen synchronization boilerplate via composable mixins and typed UseCase tasks.

nodes.label: BlocX Core Official Package Logo
nodes.rationale: Blue-to-cyan gradient X-shaped geometric logo featuring circuit/node connection points and directional arrows symbolizing reactive state flows and event broadcasting.

nodes.label: Cursor-Based Pagination Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Supports opaque pagination tokens for initial load, infinite scroll, and pull-to-refresh via BlocxCursorPaginatedUseCase and BlocxCursorPaginatedUseCaseTask; null or empty nextCursor signals end of list.

nodes.label: Sorted Collection Insertion (sortComparator)
nodes.rationale: Positions newly created or synced entities in O(n) order matching server sorting without re-sorting the entire list on updates.

nodes.label: Six Non-Negotiable BlocX Core Architectural Rules
nodes.norm_label: six non-negotiable blocx core architectural rules
nodes.rationale: Enforces Pure Dart isolation, unidirectional UseCase-only EventHub emission, exact generic signatures, internal ScreenManagerCubit ownership, auto-initialized mixins in super(), and perform() vs execute() separation.
